name: Vrykolakas
description: A revenant of Greek folk belief — an undead, often swollen and bloated corpse held to leave the grave at night and afflict the living, with strong continuity to wider Balkan vampire traditions.
origin: Strongest in the Greek-speaking world: mainland Greece, the Aegean islands (especially Mykonos, Santorini, Crete, and Chios), and historically Greek communities of Anatolia, Cyprus, and the southern Balkans.
